reasons: At most 4 MC per semester allows only one 4 MC course per semester. Semesters 5-8 provide only 4 course slots, but 5 required courses remain: CS4212, CS3234, CS4350, CS3219, CS3233.
CS4212 also requires CS2104 or CS3212; neither is completed, so CS2104 would need to be added as a prerequisite, making the capacity shortfall worse.
